description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament 2+1 ne shitje, zona e Freskut.
Ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara per banim, prej komunitet familjar qe ka.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5-te (jo i fundit) pallat me ashensor, ndertim i vitit 2010.
Organizimi dhe hapesira e apartamentit eshte ideali, korridor i vogel i cili te con te dhoma e ndenjes, me kuzhinen e vecuar, verande e bollshshme e mbyllur, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje depo.
Mobilimi i apartamentit cilesor me dru te vertet.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Apartamenti mund te blihet edhe me kredi.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
description_en: We offer a 2+1 apartment for sale, Fresk area. It is located in one of the most preferred residential areas, from the family community that it has. The apartment is located on the 5th (not the last) floor of the building with an elevator, built in 2010. The organization and space of the apartment is ideal, a small corridor that leads to the living room, with a separate kitchen, a spacious closed veranda, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a storage room. Quality apartment furniture with real wood. Has regular mortgage documentation. The apartment can also be bought with a loan. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
